rationale: The pattern 'Repair evidenced configuration smells' aims to optimize CI resources. While the workflow uses 'Swatinem/rust-cache@v2', the 'direct-minimal-versions' job performs a 'cargo update' which can be slow. I will explicitly add a caching step for the cargo registry/index to ensure that even when 'cargo update' is run, the underlying dependency metadata is cached, reducing network overhead. This follows the instruction to implement the pattern even if the benefit is uncertain.
